title: DONE (the reference picture)
scene: Narada, with his vina, speaks to a weary young woman, Bhakti, and her two aged sons on a river bank before a temple spire.
figures: already painted: ch_0_1

title: The Kumaras and Narada
scene: Narada bows with folded hands before the four youthful Kumara sages, who sit barefoot on a flat rock beside a mountain stream at Badari; snow peaks rise behind them.
light: clear dawn, antique gold with pale blue
figures: the four Kumaras seated on the right, Narada standing bowed before them

title: Cessation of Bhakti's suffering
scene: On the Ganga bank at Haridwar a great gathering listens to the Bhagavata; in the foreground Bhakti, now radiant and young, sits between her two sons, who have grown youthful and bright again.
figures: Bhakti and her two sons lower right, the reciter on a raised seat at the right, listeners in a half circle

title: Redemption of Atmadeva
scene: In a forest a sage in saffron places a single fruit in the hands of a kneeling householder brahmana, while the brahmana's wife waits anxiously behind him under a tree.
figures: the sage right of centre, the brahmana kneeling before him, his wife behind on the left of the pair

title: Gokarna and Dhundhukari
scene: In a village hall a calm ascetic, Gokarna, expounds the Bhagavata from a raised seat; at the edge a faint smoky shadow of a restless spirit sits near a tall seven-jointed bamboo that is beginning to split with light.
light: evening, amber with soft grey smoke
figures: Gokarna on the right, villagers in a half circle, the pale shadow figure beside the bamboo on the left side of the group

title: Hearing the Bhagavata in a week
scene: A village courtyard prepared for a week of recitation: a raised seat with the book on a cloth, a water pot with mango leaves, banana stems and garlands, villagers arriving with offerings.
figures: the raised seat right of centre, a few villagers carrying flowers and lamps from the left

title: Shaunaka and the sages ask Suta
scene: Sages seated in a half circle around a sacrificial fire in a forest clearing at Naimisharanya, listening to an elderly narrator on a raised seat; smoke rises into the trees.
light: late afternoon turning to dusk, saffron and amber
figures: the narrator on the right, five or six sages facing him

title: Glory of the Lord's story
scene: Suta, an elderly sage, speaks from a raised seat with a palm-leaf book on his knee; on the left a young ascetic (Shuka) is seen far away walking alone into the forest, small against the trees.
figures: Suta on the right with the sages before him, the distant young ascetic on the left edge

title: The Lord's descents
scene: The great Vishnu reclines on a coiled serpent on a calm cosmic ocean; a lotus rises from his navel; around the border of the scene, small bright figures of ten or so descents (a fish, a tortoise, a boar, a lion-faced form, a dwarf, a bowman) float on lotus clouds.
figures: Vishnu centre-right, the small descents in an arc above

title: Vyasa's frustration
scene: Vyasa, a sage with matted hair, sits alone and troubled on the steps of his hermitage on a riverbank, a palm-leaf manuscript beside him, while Narada with his vina appears on the path.
figures: Vyasa seated right of centre, Narada approaching from the left

title: Narada's previous life
scene: Narada, with his vina, sits beside the seated Vyasa and speaks to him under a tree by the river; a small vision in the sky above shows a boy serving sages.
figures: Narada and Vyasa side by side on the right

title: Narada's earlier birth continues
scene: A young boy sits alone in meditation under a peepal tree beside a quiet pond, a faint blue radiance of a form glowing in the heart of the scene; a small hut in the distance.
figures: the boy centre-right, the pond left

title: Ashvatthama and Arjuna
scene: Arjuna stands before his chariot with Krishna beside him, a young brahmana warrior bound with rope kneeling before Draupadi, who stands with calm folded hands; a flash of golden light in the sky behind.
figures: Draupadi centre, Arjuna and Krishna right, the bound youth kneeling on the left of them

title: Kunti's prayers
scene: Queen Kunti in a plain white sari stands with folded hands before Krishna's chariot, a bright blue protective glow over the young Uttara beside her; Krishna smiles from the chariot.
figures: Kunti centre-right, Krishna on the chariot at the right edge, Uttara behind Kunti

title: Bhishma on the bed of arrows
scene: The aged Bhishma lies on a bed of arrows on the battlefield at sunset, Krishna standing before him with a gentle smile; the Pandavas sit with bowed heads in the foreground.
figures: Bhishma lower right, Krishna standing right of centre, the five Pandavas seated on the left of him

title: Krishna departs for Dwaraka
scene: Krishna rides out of the city of Hastinapura in a golden chariot, the women of the city on balconies showering flowers; banners and white elephants in the road.
figures: the chariot right of centre, balconies and flowers on the left

title: Krishna received at Dwaraka
scene: The people of Dwaraka welcome Krishna at the city gate with garlands, conches and a golden pot; Krishna lifts his conch to his lips from the chariot.
figures: Krishna on the chariot right, the crowd and garlands on the left, a city wall behind

title: Birth of Parikshit
scene: The newborn prince Parikshit lies in his mother Uttara's lap in a palace courtyard, brahmanas blessing him with raised hands; the old king Yudhishthira stands smiling.
figures: Uttara with the child lower right, Yudhishthira centre, brahmanas at the left

title: Dhritarashtra leaves for the forest
scene: The blind old king Dhritarashtra and his wife Gandhari, with a blindfold, walk slowly out of the palace gate at night led by Vidura; a single lamp lights the road.
light: pre-dawn dark, saffron lamp glow and indigo
figures: the old couple centre-right, Vidura leading on the left

title: Omens
scene: Yudhishthira stands on a palace terrace looking at a storm of unusual omens: a jackal howling at the sun, a dark comet, scattered birds, while Bhima beside him looks worried.
figures: Yudhishthira right, Bhima behind him, the sky filling the left

title: The Pandavas' final journey
scene: The five Pandavas and Draupadi, in simple clothes with their dog, walk away along a mountain path toward snow peaks, the young king Parikshit watching from the palace steps far behind.
figures: the six walkers on the right climbing, Parikshit small on the left edge

title: Dharma and Mother Earth
scene: A white bull standing on one leg weeps beside a cow with tearful eyes on a riverbank, the bull as a bent old man with gentle face, the cow as a sad young woman; a faint evening star above.
figures: the bull and the cow side by side on the right

title: Parikshit subdues Kali
scene: King Parikshit on a golden chariot with drawn bow stands over a crowned figure in rough clothing who bows and folds his hands; a bull and a cow stand safe behind the king.
figures: the king and chariot right of centre, the kneeling figure in front, the bull and cow on the left

title: Shringi's curse
scene: A young sage with long hair, in anger, holds up water in his palm by a river at the hermitage gate; his old father Shamika sits in meditation, a dead snake over his shoulders.
figures: the youth right of centre, the old sage seated deeper right

title: Parikshit's vow
scene: King Parikshit sits on kusha grass on the Ganga bank, his crown laid aside, surrounded by sages with raised hands; in the distance a young radiant ascetic (Shuka) approaches along the shore.
figures: the king centre-right, sages in a half circle, Shuka on the left far along the shore

title: Meditation and the cosmic form
scene: The young ascetic Shukadeva teaches King Parikshit on the Ganga bank; above them in the golden sky the vast form of the Lord is suggested as layered heavens and seas with tiny stars drawn as lotus petals.
figures: Shuka seated on a mat right of centre, the king in front of him, the cosmic sky filling the upper half

title: Ways of liberation
scene: A lone yogi sits in meditation on a bare hilltop at sunrise, eyes closed, a faint lotus of light above his head; below him a small valley village with smoke from cooking fires.
light: sunrise, golden yellow and soft pink
figures: the yogi right of centre, the valley on the left

title: Devotion above all
scene: A line of worshippers at small wayside shrines: one with a lamp before a sage, one with grain before a mother figure, one with water toward the rising sun; behind them Shuka seated and watching with a smile.
figures: the worshippers in the middle ground, Shuka on the right

title: The king asks about creation
scene: King Parikshit with his crown laid on a cloth beside him sits with folded hands before Shukadeva on the Ganga bank; a heron stands in the shallows.
figures: the king and the young ascetic facing each other on the right

title: A description of the cosmos
scene: Narada with his vina stands before the four-faced Brahma, who sits on a great lotus; behind them the cosmos appears as rings of earth, sea and heaven rising like a mandala.
light: luminous dusk, golden yellow and deep blue
figures: Brahma on the right, Narada bowing before him

title: Glories of the cosmic being
scene: A vast luminous giant form is suggested by the landscape itself: mountains as shoulders, a river as a garland, clouds as a crown; tiny Brahma on a lotus and tiny sages look up from the lower right.
figures: the giant landscape-form across the upper centre, the small figures lower right

title: The Lord's playful descents
scene: Brahma on a lotus in a gold sky holds up a garland of small bright scenes: the boar lifting the earth, the sage Kapila teaching his mother, the two sages Nara and Narayana meditating.
figures: Brahma on the right, the scenes circling above him like a garland

title: The king asks many questions
scene: King Parikshit, leaning forward with folded hands, questions Shukadeva under a banyan at the river's edge; a line of cranes crosses the evening sky.
figures: the king and the ascetic on the right, the river on the left

title: The four verses of the Bhagavata
scene: Brahma seated on a lotus on dark primordial water hears a golden voice; far off, a luminous Vaikuntha with Vishnu on a serpent couch glows through the mist.
light: pre-dawn, golden yellow and deep blue
figures: Brahma centre-right, Vaikuntha glowing on the left

title: The ten topics of the Bhagavata
scene: Shuka sits on his mat before King Parikshit; between them a large golden lotus of ten petals rests on the ground, each petal holding a tiny symbol (a seed, a sun, a mountain, a flame, a lamp).
figures: the ascetic and the king on the right, the lotus in front of them

title: Uddhava meets Vidura
scene: On the bank of the Yamuna the grey-haired Uddhava, in plain robes, rises to greet Vidura, who arrives on foot with a staff and a small bundle; kadamba trees overhead.
figures: Uddhava on the right, Vidura approaching from the left of him

title: Uddhava remembers Krishna's childhood
scene: Uddhava, grey and moved, sits on a rock beside Vidura and speaks; in the sky above them a small bright vision of boy Krishna lifting a hill over cowherds.
figures: the two men seated on the right, the vision above and left

title: Krishna's other deeds
scene: Uddhava tells Vidura about Krishna; a luminous vision of Krishna with Rukmini in a flower-decked chariot rises over a city skyline in the mist above them.
figures: the two men on the right, the vision in the upper left of centre

title: Uddhava sends Vidura to Maitreya
scene: Krishna sits quietly under a peepal tree at the river's edge at evening and Uddhava bows before him; in the foreground Vidura turns away on a path toward the north.
figures: Krishna and Uddhava on the right, Vidura walking left

title: Vidura meets Maitreya
scene: Vidura bows with folded hands before the sage Maitreya, who sits on a deerskin on the Ganga bank at Haridwar, steps going down to the water behind.
figures: Maitreya on the right, Vidura bowing in front

title: The cosmic body appears
scene: An enormous egg-shaped cosmos floats on a dark primordial sea, a luminous form beginning to rise from it; lotus clouds and tiny stars around.
figures: the egg right of centre

title: Vidura's questions
scene: Vidura leans forward with a raised hand, asking the seated sage Maitreya under a great tree at the river's edge, a lamp and a palm-leaf book at their side.
figures: Maitreya on the right, Vidura in front

title: Brahma appears on the lotus
scene: Brahma with four faces rises on a great lotus from the navel of Vishnu, who lies asleep on the coiled serpent over dark waters; Brahma looks out in four directions.
figures: Vishnu below, Brahma on the lotus at the centre-right

title: Brahma praises the Lord
scene: Brahma, seated on his lotus, bows with folded hands before Vishnu, who appears radiant and four-armed on the serpent couch; golden light fills the sea.
figures: Brahma on the left of centre, Vishnu on the right

title: The tenfold creation
scene: Brahma on a lotus above a newly made world, trees, birds, deer, snakes and bright celestial beings rising across a green landscape in gentle rows.
figures: Brahma above on the right, the creatures spread below

title: The measure of time
scene: A great wheel of twelve spokes turns slowly across a sky with a sun disc; below, a village at dawn, a farmer with oxen and a woman drawing water.
figures: the wheel in the upper right, the village on the lower left

title: The Kumaras refuse
scene: The four boy sages (Kumaras) stand before the four-faced Brahma on his lotus and calmly decline; a troop of new creatures waits in the distance.
figures: Brahma on the right, the four boys in front of him

title: The divine Boar lifts the Earth
scene: The great Boar, blue-black with golden tusks, rises from the waters bearing the green Earth on his tusks, sea spray around him, sages in the sky praising.
figures: the Boar centre-right, the sages above on the left

title: Diti's request
scene: Kashyapa sits in meditation by a small fire at dusk; Diti approaches him with downcast eyes and folded hands between two trees; a thin moon above.
figures: Kashyapa on the right, Diti on the left of him

title: The Kumaras curse the gatekeepers
scene: At a golden gate of Vaikuntha, two guards with maces bar the way to four boy sages who stand calm; blossoming wish-trees and a white marble hall behind.
light: bright noon, ochre and pearl white
figures: the guards on the left, the boys right of them

title: The fall of Jaya and Vijaya
scene: Vishnu with Lakshmi comes out to the gate to meet the sages; the two guards kneel with bowed heads before them.
figures: Vishnu and Lakshmi on the right, the sages centre, the guards kneeling on the left

title: Birth of the two demon brothers
scene: Diti sits in a hermitage courtyard with two very large baby boys at her feet; a dark comet crosses a restless sky, a jackal in the distance.
figures: Diti on the right, the boys beside her

title: The Boar meets Hiranyaksha
scene: In a vast sea, the Boar stands holding the Earth while a huge demon with a mace rises from the waves to challenge him; Varuna watches from the left.
light: stormy dawn, ochre and deep blue
figures: the Boar on the right, the demon on the left of him

title: The Boar's victory
scene: The Boar stands calm in the sea with the Earth on his tusks as gods in the sky shower flowers, Brahma on his lotus above, the sea shining.
figures: the Boar on the right, the flowers falling from the left

title: The many kinds of beings
scene: Brahma on a lotus above a thriving world: cows, horses, deer, birds and trees in a wide meadow, Manu and his wife below with folded hands.
figures: Brahma upper right, Manu and his wife lower right, the animals on the left

title: Kardama's penance
scene: The sage Kardama, thin and radiant, sits by the lake Bindu among lotuses; Vishnu appears before him on a golden eagle in the sky with a smile.
figures: Kardama on the right, Vishnu in the sky on the left of him

title: Devahuti is offered to Kardama
scene: King Manu and Queen Shatarupa bring their daughter Devahuti, in a plain sari, with folded hands, to Kardama's leaf hut at his hermitage.
figures: Kardama on the right, the family on the left

title: Kardama and Devahuti's home
scene: A shining aerial palace with domes and flags floats above a lotus garden; on its balcony Kardama and Devahuti look at the garden, a lake below.
figures: the palace right of centre, the garden below

title: The birth of Kapila
scene: Devahuti sits holding the radiant infant Kapila while Kardama bows to him; Brahma and sages come with blessings.
figures: Devahuti and the baby right of centre, Kardama and the sages on the left of them

title: Kapila teaches his mother
scene: The young sage Kapila sits on a deerskin in the hermitage garden, speaking gently to his mother Devahuti, who sits in front of him with folded hands.
figures: Kapila on the right, Devahuti in front of him

title: The unfolding of the principles
scene: Kapila and Devahuti sit in the garden while behind them a great golden lotus opens in many rings like a mandala of earth, water, fire, air and sky.
figures: the two on the right, the lotus mandala behind and left

title: The soul and nature
scene: Kapila points to a lamp flame and a mirror set between himself and his seated mother; the flame lights both their faces.
figures: Kapila on the right, Devahuti seated in front, the lamp between them

title: The practice of yoga
scene: Devahuti sits in a meditation posture on kusha grass in front of the hermitage, eyes lowered, a lotus of light faint above her; Kapila stands guiding her.
figures: Devahuti centre-right, Kapila standing at the right edge

title: Devotion and the flow of time
scene: Kapila and Devahuti sit by a river; above them in the sky a great circle of time with sun and moon and the seasons as small bright scenes around it.
figures: the two on the right, the circle of time upper left

title: Men bound to their homes
scene: A rich household at dusk: a merchant counts coins, his family around a lamp; outside a dark cloud shaped like a great hand creeps over the roof.
figures: the house right of centre, the dark cloud above

title: Life before birth
scene: A calm young mother sits resting in a garden, her hands folded in her lap; above them a golden lotus bud holds a tiny curled child of light.
figures: the mother on the right, the lotus bud above her

title: Two paths
scene: Two roads divide at a hillside at dusk: the left one dark with smoke and thorns, the right one bright with flowers leading to the moon; Kapila stands pointing at the bright one, a traveller before him.
figures: Kapila and the traveller on the right, the paths going left

title: Devahuti attains wisdom
scene: Devahuti sits peacefully in meditation on a river bank at dawn near her hut; far away Kapila walks off along the shore toward the northern sea.
figures: Devahuti on the right, Kapila small on the left

title: Manu's daughters and their children
scene: Sage Atri and his wife Anasuya sit before their leaf hut holding three small radiant sons: one in white with a crescent glow, one in saffron with a staff, one with a fiery bright gaze.
light: late afternoon, leaf green and gold
figures: the family on the right, the hut behind them on the left

title: Shiva and Daksha quarrel
scene: In a great assembly of sages and gods, the stern king Daksha rises and points in anger toward Shiva, who sits calm with matted hair, ash and crescent moon.
light: harsh noon, leaf green and ivory
figures: Shiva seated on the right, Daksha standing and pointing from the left of him

title: Sati asks to go
scene: Sati in a white and gold sari stands with folded hands before Shiva beneath the snow peak of Kailasa, the white bull Nandi beside them; in the sky aerial cars of the gods hurry toward Daksha's sacrifice.
light: morning, leaf green and snow white
figures: Shiva and Sati on the right, the bull near them, the aerial cars on the left

title: Sati and the fire of yoga
scene: Sati sits in yoga posture on the sacrificial ground, a golden fire of light rising around her; the gods and sages stand stunned and Daksha turns away.
light: dusk, leaf green and fire gold
figures: Sati centre-right, the gods and sages left and behind

title: Virabhadra rises
scene: On Kailasa Shiva strikes a lock of his matted hair to the ground and from the flames a colossal dark warrior with many arms rises, armed and radiant.
light: stormy dusk, leaf green and vermilion
figures: Shiva on the right, the warrior rising in the centre

title: The gods appease Shiva
scene: Brahma, Vishnu and the gods bow with folded hands before Shiva, who sits under a great banyan on Kailasa, a stream flowing past.
light: clear morning, leaf green and silver
figures: Shiva seated on the right, the gods bowing in a half circle

title: The sacrifice is completed
scene: Shiva blesses Daksha, who kneels with folded hands in the restored sacrificial hall; a calm fire burns and Vishnu appears in the sky on his golden eagle.
light: bright afternoon, leaf green and gold
figures: Shiva and Daksha right of centre, Vishnu in the upper left

title: Dhruva goes to the forest
scene: A five-year-old boy, Dhruva, walks into a forest with Narada showing the way and his mother far behind at the edge of the wood.
figures: Dhruva and Narada on the right, the mother small on the left

title: Dhruva sees the Lord
scene: The boy Dhruva stands with folded hands in a forest glade before the four-armed Vishnu, who touches the boy's cheek with his conch; a soft golden light fills the trees.
light: luminous dusk, leaf green and gold
figures: Dhruva and Vishnu on the right

title: Dhruva and the Yakshas
scene: Dhruva stands in a chariot with his bow, facing a misty mountain valley of Alaka with tall pale towers and swirling illusions.
light: grey dawn, leaf green and mist
figures: the chariot on the right, the valley on the left

title: Manu calms Dhruva
scene: The old Manu and sages arrive at the field; Dhruva lowers his bow and bows with folded hands to his grandfather, the mist clearing.
figures: Manu and Dhruva on the right, sages behind

title: Dhruva ascends
scene: Dhruva rises in a golden celestial car above the forest, his mother Suniti waving from below; a single bright pole star above them.
light: evening, leaf green and deep blue
figures: the car in the upper right, the mother on the lower left

title: Dhruva's family; King Anga
scene: King Anga pours ghee into a sacrificial fire among priests in a hall; the fire burns bright but the gods do not come, and the king looks troubled.
figures: the king on the right, the priests around the fire

title: King Vena
scene: Sages stand before the proud King Vena on his throne in a palace hall and plead with raised hands; Vena turns his face away and gestures them off.
light: bright noon, leaf green and ivory
figures: Vena on the right, the sages on the left

title: Prithu is crowned
scene: The young King Prithu, radiant, holding a bow, is anointed by sages and gods with golden pots beside Queen Archi; garlands and gifts are spread in front.
light: bright morning, leaf green and gold
figures: Prithu and Archi on the right, the sages on the left

title: The bards praise Prithu
scene: Bards stand before King Prithu seated on his throne in a hall and sing with folded hands; petals fall; the king smiles modestly.
figures: Prithu on the right, the bards on the left

title: Prithu and the Earth
scene: King Prithu with a drawn bow follows a golden cow that runs through a forest; the cow turns and folds her hooves in prayer.
figures: the king on the right, the cow in the centre

title: Prithu milks the Earth
scene: A golden cow stands in a green meadow; King Prithu kneels with a bowl and Manu as a calf at her side, groups of sages, gods and others waiting in rows with their vessels.
light: spring morning, leaf green and gold
figures: the cow right of centre, the groups lining the left

title: A hundred horse sacrifices
scene: A white sacrificial horse with a garland is led across a wide field followed by Prithu's young son; in the distant sky a cloaked figure (Indra) hovers behind a cloud.
light: bright morning, leaf green and gold
figures: the horse and the prince on the right, the cloud on the left

title: Vishnu appears at the sacrifice
scene: In Prithu's sacrificial hall Vishnu appears radiant and four-armed; Prithu and Indra bow with folded hands at his feet.
light: luminous noon, leaf green and gold
figures: Vishnu on the right, Prithu and Indra bowing on the left of him

title: Prithu teaches the people
scene: King Prithu sits on a raised throne in a festive city square, with flags and flower garlands, addressing a gathering of citizens who sit and listen.
figures: the king on the right, the gathering on the left

title: The Kumaras teach Prithu
scene: Four boy sages descend from the sky to the palace garden; King Prithu hurries to welcome them with folded hands and a golden seat.
light: bright morning, leaf green and gold
figures: the boys on the right, the king meeting them from the left

title: Prithu retires to the forest
scene: The aged King Prithu and Queen Archi sit in meditation by a forest stream; a soft golden light rises over them.
light: early dusk, leaf green and gold
figures: the two on the right, the stream on the left

title: Shiva teaches the Pracetas
scene: The ten brother Pracetas sit in a row on a seashore with folded hands while Shiva stands before them, speaking, the sea reaching the horizon.
figures: Shiva on the right, the ten brothers sitting in front

title: The parable of Puranjana begins
scene: Narada speaks to King Prachinabarhi in a palace garden; above them in the mist a city with nine gates is faintly drawn like a dream.
figures: Narada and the king on the right, the dream city in the sky on the left

title: Puranjana goes hunting
scene: King Puranjana rides out of his city gate in a chariot with a bow; his queen watches sadly from a window at the left.
figures: the chariot on the right, the queen at the window on the left

title: Danger comes to the city
scene: A fortified city with nine gates under a darkening sky; riders gather at the edge of the plain and an old woman in dark cloth stands at the gate.
figures: the city on the right, the riders on the left

title: Puranjana is reborn
scene: A woman weeps beside a pond while a radiant swan-like friend (Avijnata, a gentle sage) consoles her; two swans float on the water.
figures: the woman and the sage on the right, the pond on the left

title: Narada explains the parable
scene: Narada sits on a deerskin in a hall of sages before King Prachinabarhi, a lamp between them, the king bowing in thought.
light: evening lamp-light, leaf green and amber
figures: Narada on the right, the king in front

title: The Pracetas return from the sea
scene: The ten Pracetas rise from the seashore after their penance; the land behind them is thick with tall trees, and the moon god Soma offers a young maiden to them.
light: dusk, leaf green and moon silver
figures: the brothers on the right, the trees and Soma on the left

title: Narada instructs the Pracetas
scene: The ten brothers sit on the seashore with folded hands while Narada, with his vina, speaks to them; a small vision of Vishnu glows above the waves.
figures: Narada on the right, the brothers in front, the vision upper left

title: Priyavrata circles the sun
scene: A radiant king in a golden chariot with a single wheel drives swiftly round the flank of a great mountain following the sun's glow; in the track of the wheels thin ribbons of water fill and shine.
light: golden dusk chasing light, jade and gold
figures: the chariot on the right, the glowing horizon behind on the left

title: Agnidhra
scene: A young king sits by a flowering stream worshipping with flowers; a graceful celestial woman with anklets approaches through the trees with shy eyes.
light: late morning, jade green and rose
figures: the king on the right, the celestial woman coming from the left

title: The Lord comes as Rishabha
scene: King Nabhi and Queen Merudevi bow with folded hands in a sacrificial hall as four-armed Vishnu appears in the fire's glow with a smile; sages around bow.
light: bright noon, jade green and gold
figures: Vishnu on the right, the king and queen kneeling in front

title: Rishabha rules
scene: The young King Rishabha sits on a throne with his queen Jayanti in a lush green city; rain falls on fields beyond a balcony after a long dry spell; elders bow.
light: rain-washed afternoon, jade green and silver
figures: the king and queen on the right, the rain on the left

title: Rishabha teaches his sons
scene: Rishabha sits on a stone seat in a garden speaking calmly to his many sons, who sit around him in a half circle; flowering trees overhead.
figures: Rishabha on the right, the sons in front

title: Rishabha leaves the world
scene: A serene ascetic in a plain cloth with matted hair walks calmly along a forest path toward a distant glowing forest fire under a wide sky.
light: evening glow, jade green and ember
figures: the ascetic on the right, the fire glow on the left horizon

title: King Bharata
scene: King Bharata, crowned and gentle, kneels at a clear river bank at dawn to worship with flowers and a small dark stone, his palace far behind, a forest on the right.
figures: the king on the right, the river on the left

title: Bharata and the fawn
scene: An ascetic with matted hair, Bharata, gently holds a newborn fawn in his arms on a river bank at evening; the mother deer stands far off across the water.
figures: Bharata and the fawn on the right, the mother deer small on the left

title: Jada Bharata
scene: A calm young man in rough cloth sits in a field guarding the crop, quiet and still; in the distance a hut and brothers reading under a tree.
figures: the youth on the right, the hut on the left

title: The king's palanquin
